Eyes tired, dry and sore after a day on screens? You're not imagining it.
When you stare at a screen, you blink far less, and the tiny muscles that focus your eyes stay locked tight.
Try the twenty, twenty, twenty rule. Every twenty minutes, look at something twenty feet away for twenty seconds.
Headaches or blurry vision that won't go away? Book an eye test. Otherwise... your eyes will thank you.
